title: Easy Smoky American Corn Wrap
description: A kid-friendly American dish featuring corn arepa filled with mozzarella cheese, wrapped in a lotus leaf wrap with a smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the cornmeal, smoked paprika, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and stir until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a quarter cup of shredded mozzarella cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half-circle shape and press the edges together to seal.
Place a lotus leaf on a flat surface and put a corn arepa in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the arepa to form a wrap and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Melt the butter in the preheated skillet and cook the wraps for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
